mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mdf_industry_taxonomy (taxonomy_code, taxonomy_name, provider_code, is_mutually_exclusive, note) VALUES (#{taxonomyCode}, #{taxonomyName}, #{providerCode}, #{isMutuallyExclusive}, #{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE taxonomy_name = VALUES(taxonomy_name), provider_code = VALUES(provider_code), is_mutually_exclusive = VALUES(is_mutually_exclusive), note = VALUES(note)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mdf_industry_taxonomy ORDER BY taxonomy_code
